description: Checksum-pinned present-day oceanic crustal age distribution used only as an external Earth validation target.

sources.dataset: Seton et al. 2020 present-day oceanic crustal age
sources.source_citation: Seton, M., Muller, R. D., Zahirovic, S., Williams, S., Wright, N. M., Cannon, J., Whittaker, J. M., Matthews, K. J., and McGirr, R. (2020). A Global Data Set of Present-Day Oceanic Crustal Age and Seafloor Spreading Parameters.
sources.source_processing: Parse finite ages from the 1801 by 3601 grid in canonical file order; apply longitude endpoint trapezoid factors and exact spherical latitude-band factors; compute the finite-ocean weighted mean and inclusive age<=threshold CDF ordinates.
sources.source_version: Seton et al. 2020 release 2020.1, Gee and Kent 2007 timescale
